text_block_list.text:
Cesario got injured,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
I have a special favor to ask.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you know, but about training—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: As someone aiming to become an instructor in the future, I would never do something so reckless.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "However, even amidst all this, I want to explore ways to minimize the decline in motor function as much as possible."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If we construct a regimen combining
various treatments with light exercise—
choice_data_list: Even so, you should recover a bit before you do it.
Easier said than done, but... let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Even if it's the long way around, it's not a step backward. Trust me.

text_block_list.text: Cesario ended up taking a period of rest...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate it.
I wanted to explore every possible avenue.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, whether it succeeds or fails,
the day will come when you can put this experience to good use in the future.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You've strained a muscle here, haven't you?
Apart from the injury you had before, that is.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's the risk of continuing to move while favoring an injury.
I've minimized the strain as much as possible, but I cannot allow any exercise until further notice.

Perhaps impatience played a part.
Another injury developed alongside it, prolonging the recovery.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Looks like the natural movement is coming back a bit.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alongside electrotherapy and thermotherapy, perform exercise as appropriate within feasible limits to prevent loss of motor function...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If we follow the hospital's guided pace,
we can keep the risk of worsening it to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: At this rate, an early comeback should come first. Please wait for me just a little longer.
Cesario's efforts paid off, and she was able to return to regular training sooner than originally expected.
